name: @blackveil/bv-dns-security-mcp
description: cf build/deploy package for the main bv-dns-security-mcp Worker (config only; the entrypoint stays at src/index.ts)

scripts.guard:overlay-env: node -e "if (process.env.BV_DEPLOY_OVERLAY_PATH) { console.error('Refusing to deploy: BV_DEPLOY_OVERLAY_PATH is a test hook that points cloudflare.config.ts at a different overlay than the one the injector validated. Unset it and re-run.'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.deploy: npm run guard:overlay-env && cf deploy --mode production
scripts.deploy:staged: npm run guard:overlay-env && cf workers versions create --mode production
scripts.deploy:triggers: npm run guard:overlay-env && cf workers triggers deploy --mode production
